major_cooldowns.name: Odyn's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Lead with it to trigger Enrage, and press it just before or after Bloodthirst so Bloodborne buffs its bleed; the 4pc shaves 2.5 sec off its cooldown per Rampage, so it comes back roughly twice as often.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 385060 is the cast id observed in the sampled top parse; 385059 is the talent row carrying the 45 sec base cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it right after the opening Odyn's Fury and then on cooldown; Rage generation jumps 50%, so hold Rampage until 100+ Rage during the window instead of spending it the moment it is affordable.

major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it with Recklessness, safely macroed together since both sit on the same cooldown and both are pulled forward by Anger Management, and spend the window on Thunder Blast and the discounted Thunder Clap.

major_cooldowns.name: Bladestorm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it inside Recklessness, or when Recklessness is more than 30 sec away, always with Enrage already running and ideally straight off a fresh Rampage; three stacks of Imminent Demise lighting the button is not a cue to hold it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 446035 is the cast id observed in the sampled top parse at a 1.5 min cooldown; the guide links the 46924 talent row.

major_cooldowns.name: Wrecking Throw
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: A strong ranged filler on cooldown, and against a target with an absorb shield it gains a 500% multiplier, so press it second only to applying Enrage to strip the shield fast.

defensives.name: Enraged Regeneration
defensives.usage_rule: Your main personal: use it preemptively ahead of a known damage spike and keep Bloodthirst rolling across the 8 sec for the extra 20% healing on top of the 30% damage reduction.

defensives.name: Die by the Sword
defensives.usage_rule: 30% damage reduction and full parry for 8 sec; save it for physical burst you cannot outheal.

defensives.name: Rallying Cry
defensives.usage_rule: Raid-wide 10% temporary health: assign it to a key encounter mechanic rather than treating it as a personal, and remember it costs a global.

defensives.name: Berserker Rage
defensives.usage_rule: Break and immune Fear, Sap and Incapacitate effects; press it on the mechanic that would otherwise take you off the boss.

defensives.name: Spell Reflection
defensives.usage_rule: Reflect the first spell cast on you and cut magic damage by 20% for 5 sec; time it into a targeted cast rather than pressing it blind.

defensives.name: Impending Victory
defensives.usage_rule: A 30% max-health heal on a short cooldown; weave it during sustained damage instead of banking it.

rules.description: Open Charge, Odyn's Fury, Recklessness, Rampage
rules.action: Charge in, Odyn's Fury to trigger Enrage, then Recklessness (macroed with Avatar) before the first Rampage.
Enrage is worth 30-50% of your damage: cast Rampage before it expires, and re-trigger it with Odyn's Fury or Bloodthirst when Rampage is not affordable.
Delay Rampage past its 80 Rage cost to 100+ Rage (110 in AoE), and only press it early when Enrage has less than a global left.

Fire Execute while Sudden Death is up. It stacks to 2 so you may hold one briefly, but never let it expire unspent: as Slayer each spend also pulls Bladestorm's cooldown forward by your Executioner stacks.

Below 20% target health, 35% with Massacre, Execute takes over as the filler and outranks Bloodbath, Crushing Blow, Bloodthirst, Raging Blow and Whirlwind. In AoE inside Recklessness, Bloodbath and Whirlwind come first.
Rampage first, then Bladestorm with more than 1 sec of Enrage left; Fresh Meat or Deft Experience carry Enrage through the channel.
Send Bladestorm early inside Recklessness to overlap its triggers; outside the window only press it when Recklessness is more than 30 sec from being ready, or to catch a pack of adds.
Macro Avatar to Recklessness: both sit on a 90 sec cooldown and both are reduced by Anger Management, so they stay paired all fight.
Sandwich Odyn's Fury against a Bloodthirst, either side, so Bloodborne is live and its bleed lands 20% harder.

source_summary: Fury is a Rage feedback loop: Rampage triggers Enrage, Enrage buffs everything that generates the next Rampage, and the sources treat Enrage uptime as the spec's single most important metric. Odyn's Fury opens and jumpstarts Enrage, Recklessness is the burst anchor (macroed with Avatar on the Mountain Thane side, since they share a 90 sec cooldown and Anger Management reduction), and Slayer's Bladestorm is spent inside Recklessness or only when Recklessness is more than 30 sec away, always with Enrage already running. Rampage is deliberately delayed past its 80 Rage cost to 100+ Rage to pool for the next cycle, while Sudden Death procs are dumped into Execute before they overcap.
